_comment: Build-time snapshot of /api/content, bundled so the site paints instantly even when the API is cold. Regenerate with `npm run snapshot` (runs automatically on `npm run build`). Values below are the committed fallback used when the API is unreachable at build time.

featured.name: Quantfolio
featured.description: Portfolio risk and mean-variance analytics for NSE-listed equities: a Streamlit terminal over a C++17 quant core and a reproducible data pipeline.
highlights: C++17 core bound via ctypes: efficient frontier computation from 57s to 150ms, a 380x speedup.
FISTA optimiser with exact projections for max-Sharpe and min-variance, validated against SciPy SLSQP.
Data pipeline with nine quality gates, a Parquet lake, point-in-time corporate action adjustment and idempotent ingest.
Covers Sharpe, Sortino, VaR/CVaR, max drawdown, Euler risk decomposition and Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage.
102 tests across three operating systems on GitHub Actions, plus Docker deployment.

featured.name: FinSight OS
featured.description: A financial statement analysis and three-statement modelling terminal. Ingests company financials from multiple sources, normalises accounting nomenclature, then runs ratios, forensic review and forecasting.
highlights: Linked three-statement models built from live financial data, with balance sheet integrity validation.
15+ ratios including DuPont decomposition, liquidity, efficiency and solvency metrics.
Trend analysis across five years of history, with an automated health verdict per category.

featured.name: Tutora
featured.description: A full-stack CRM for solo educators: multi-student and parent management, batches, fees, test scores and automated reminders, with a parent portal for real-time visibility.
highlights: Shareable onboarding and test-submission links, eliminating manual data entry.
MediaPipe facial recognition for automated attendance marking.
Teacher calendar with auto-reminders triggered by scheduled tests and events; all data exportable to Excel.

featured.name: PacketLens
featured.description: A real-time network packet visualiser: parses Wireshark JSON, resolves addresses to geolocation and renders live traffic on an interactive global map.
highlights: Real-time pipeline parsing Wireshark output and resolving IPs to geolocation through external APIs.
Set-based destination deduplication, so no repeated destination is ever rendered.
Firebase for secure authentication and cloud storage.

featured.name: Low Frequency Trading Infra
featured.description: A live market-data and execution stack: Binance WebSocket ingestion feeding a rolling metrics engine, a strategy layer and stateful position and P&L tracking.
highlights: Binance WebSocket feeds with auto-reconnect and exponential backoff for fault tolerance.
Producer-consumer threading over a lock-free queue.
Rolling metrics engine covering moving averages and volatility.
Stateful position and P&L tracking persisted to SQLite, behind a rate-limited REST layer.
